section: Reddi kingdoms of Addanki, Kondavidu and Rajahmundry - Prolaya Vema Reddi, Kumaragiri Reddi

accepted.s: Which of the following works was authored by Pedakomati Vema Reddi and deals with the Srngara aspect of Amaru Shatakam?
accepted.x: Srngara Dipika was authored by Pedakomati Vema Reddi and deals with Amaru Shatakam. Tatva Prakashika was written by Sivalinga Reddi, while Kridabhiramam was written by Vinukonda Vallabhamatya.
accepted.tq: Use author–work association and eliminate works belonging to the same literary period.

accepted.s:
Consider the following pairs:
1. Pedakomati Vema Reddi — Saptasati Saratika
2. Pedakomati Vema Reddi — Bhava Dipika
3. Sivalinga Reddi — Tatva Prakashika
4. Vinukonda Vallabhamatya — Kridabhiramam
Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
accepted.x: All four pairs are correctly matched. Saptasati Saratika, Bhava Dipika, Tatva Prakashika and Kridabhiramam are associated respectively with the authors named in the statements.
accepted.tq: Verify each author–work pair independently before selecting the coded combination.

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements regarding the Reddi kingdom is correct?
o: Sanskrit served as the official language, and several rulers were scholar-poets.
Telugu was the only official language, and Sanskrit works were prohibited.
Persian served as the official language, and literary works were mainly composed by ministers.
Prakrit alone served as the official language, and rulers avoided literary activities.
accepted.x: Sanskrit was the official language of the Reddi kingdom, and many of its kings were scholar-poets themselves.
accepted.tq: Prefer the precise institutional statement and reject absolute language claims such as “alone” and “only.”

accepted.s: Kumaragiri Reddi was associated with which title in connection with the Vasantotsavam celebrations?
accepted.x: Kumaragiri Reddi held the title Karpura Vasanta Rayalu in connection with the grand Vasantotsavam celebrations.
accepted.tq: Match a ruler with the distinctive title directly associated with his activity.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about Kumaragiri Reddi:
1. His accession was opposed by Pedakomati Vema.
2. Pedakomati Vema was pacified by being made a feudatory of Chandolu and designated as heir.
3. Kumaragiri made Rajahmundry a separate division under his son Anavota and later under Kataya Vema.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. Kumaragiri settled the succession opposition by assigning Pedakomati Vema the Chandolu feudatory position and heirship, and later divided the kingdom by creating a separate Rajahmundry division.
accepted.tq: Check the sequence of political settlement and administrative division rather than treating the events as unrelated.

accepted.s:
Arrange the following events relating to Kumaragiri Reddi in chronological order:
A. Kataya Vema was placed in charge of the Rajahmundry division.
B. Kumaragiri died in refuge at Rajahmundry.
C. Kumaragiri made Rajahmundry a separate division under Anavota.
D. Pedakomati Vema seized Kondavidu.
accepted.x: Rajahmundry was first placed under Anavota, later under Kataya Vema in 1395, and Pedakomati Vema seized Kondavidu in 1402 before Kumaragiri died in refuge at Rajahmundry.
accepted.tq: Anchor the sequence with the dated event of 1395 and the final event of 1402.

accepted.s: Which of the following was a consequence of Kumaragiri Reddi’s political arrangement with Pedakomati Vema?
o: Pedakomati Vema was appointed minister at Motupalli.
Pedakomati Vema was made commander of the Rajahmundry division.
Pedakomati Vema was sent as governor of Cuttack.
Pedakomati Vema became a feudatory of Chandolu and was made heir.
accepted.x: To settle the opposition to Kumaragiri’s accession, Pedakomati Vema was made a feudatory of Chandolu and designated as heir.
accepted.tq: Identify the political settlement that logically follows from the succession dispute.

accepted.s: Which of the following statements about the political career of Kataya Vema Reddi is correct?
o: He built the Patala Ganga steps at Srisailam in 1346.
He seized Kondavidu in 1402 and caused Kumaragiri’s death.
He conquered the eastern region up to Cuttack and later administered Rajahmundry.
He abolished the tax on gold and issued the Abhaya Sasanam at Motupalli.
accepted.x: Kataya Vema, Kumaragiri’s brother-in-law and commander, conquered the eastern region up to Cuttack and later took charge of the Rajahmundry division. The other statements refer to Anavota or Pedakomati Vema, or to Prolaya Vema.
accepted.tq: Use the wrong-ruler trap by matching each deed with the correct ruler.

accepted.s: Pedakomati Vema Reddi ruled approximately during which period?
accepted.x: Pedakomati Vema Reddi ruled from 1402 to 1420.
accepted.tq: Use the distinctive middle-period dates to separate successive Reddi rulers.

accepted.s: Which Reddi ruler abolished the tax imposed on gold?
accepted.x: Anavota Reddi abolished the tax on gold. This measure is distinct from the maternity tax associated with Racha Vema Reddi.
accepted.tq: Distinguish rulers by the specific tax measure associated with each one.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Anavota Reddi abolished the tax on gold.
2. Somaya was the minister of Anavota Reddi.
3. The Abhaya Sasanam at Motupalli was connected with encouraging trade.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. Anavota abolished the gold tax, while his minister Somaya issued the Abhaya Sasanam at Motupalli to encourage trade.
accepted.tq: Combine ruler, minister and purpose into one factual chain before choosing the code.

accepted.s: Which one of the following records is correctly matched with its historical association?
o: Srisailam record — Prolaya Vema Reddi’s Patala Ganga steps
Sarpavaram record — Anavota Reddi’s capital shift
Motupalli record — Pedakomati Vema’s seizure of Kondavidu
accepted.x: The 1346 Srisailam record refers to the Patala Ganga steps built by Prolaya Vema Reddi. The Manyapuram record concerns Anavota’s capital shift, and the Sarpavaram record concerns Kataya Vema’s family.
accepted.tq: Find the correctly matched place–record association and reject swapped locations.

accepted.s: The Srisailam record dated 1346 is particularly associated with which of the following works?
o: Construction of Jaganobbaganda canals by Racha Vema
Construction of steps to Patala Ganga by Prolaya Vema Reddi
Issue of the Abhaya Sasanam by Somaya
accepted.x: The 1346 Srisailam record is associated with the steps to Patala Ganga built by Prolaya Vema Reddi.
accepted.tq: Link a dated inscription with the specific ruler and public work mentioned in it.

accepted.s: Anitalli, associated with the Kaluvacheru inscription, was related to the Reddi ruling family in which of the following ways?
o: She was Anavota Reddi’s daughter and married Somaya.
She was Kumaragiri Reddi’s daughter and married Kataya Vema.
She was Pedakomati Vema’s wife and married Racha Vema Reddi.
She was Kataya Vema’s daughter and married Veerabhadra Reddi.
accepted.x: Anitalli was the daughter of Kataya Vema Reddi and married Veerabhadra Reddi, the second son of Allada.
accepted.tq: Use family-relationship pairing to distinguish closely related Reddi queens and rulers.

accepted.s: The Kaluvacheru inscription of 1423 was issued after which event?
o: The seizure of Kondavidu by Pedakomati Vema
The construction of Patala Ganga steps at Srisailam
The abolition of the gold tax by Anavota
accepted.x: Anitalli issued the Kaluvacheru inscription in 1423 after the recapture of Rajahmundry. It also provides information on the Musunuri-led liberation and Prolaya Vema Reddi’s service under the Nayakas.
accepted.tq: Associate an inscription with its date and the event immediately preceding its issue.

accepted.s: Which of the following statements about Anitalli is correct?
o: She was the ruler who abolished the gold tax.
She was the minister who issued the Motupalli Abhaya Sasanam.
She was the queen who dug the tank associated with Pedakomati Vema.
She was regarded as the rightful heir after her father Kataya Vema Reddi.
accepted.x: Anitalli, the daughter of Kataya Vema Reddi and wife of Veerabhadra Reddi, was regarded as the rightful heir after her father.
accepted.tq: Separate succession claims from the administrative and welfare activities of other figures.

accepted.s: Who constructed the Jaganobbaganda canals to supply water to the tank dug by Surambika?
o: Somaya, the minister of Anavota Reddi
accepted.x: Racha Vema, the son of Surambika, constructed the Jaganobbaganda canals to feed water into the tank dug by his mother.
accepted.tq: Identify the family relationship first, then connect the person with the associated irrigation work.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the Reddi queens and public works:
1. Royal women participated actively in the construction of tanks, canals and reservoirs.
2. Surambika was the wife of Pedakomati Vema Reddi.
3. Racha Vema supplied water to Surambika’s tank through Jaganobbaganda canals.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. Reddi royal women took part in welfare works, Surambika was Pedakomati Vema’s wife, and her son Racha Vema provided canal irrigation to her tank.
accepted.tq: Test the institution, individual and specific work together without confusing the queen with her son.

accepted.s: Which of the following statements is NOT correctly matched?
o: Patala Ganga steps — Pedakomati Vema Reddi
accepted.x: The Patala Ganga steps at Srisailam were associated with Prolaya Vema Reddi, not Pedakomati Vema Reddi. The other three pairs are correctly matched.
accepted.tq: Find the swapped ruler–work pair while checking the location and person together.
